name: Christopher Neale

education.detail: Classes in Machine Learning, Cloud Computing and Data Analysis

experience.role: Senior Manager, Marketing Insights & CRM Analytics
bullets: Built an autonomous data enrichment pipeline connecting LLM APIs to the CRM database, generating personalized outreach content and powering a lead-scoring model prioritizing high-value accounts.

Led a CRM systems transformation (HubSpot governance, scalable data architecture, deduplication workflows, Master Data Management), then redesigned performance dashboards and attribution frameworks connecting marketing activity to acquisition, retention, and high-value segments.
Shipped a Python pricing tool for the retail sales team that analyzed competitor pricing and directly shaped 2026 pricing strategy.

Migrated the company website off a legacy CMS to a custom-built site with data pipelines for active quoting, and implemented its conversion tracking: Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel and Conversions API, and Google Ads conversion tracking.
Set up offline conversion uploads sending downstream CRM outcomes back to ad platforms, so campaigns optimize on qualified leads and sales rather than form fills.
Developed AI proposal and agreement tools enabling the sales team to build company-approved assets quickly at scale.
Partnered with commercial and finance leadership on sales performance, attribution and forecasting analytics.
Built CRM/ESP integrations (SQL, JSON REST APIs) syncing behavioral data into Iterable for 10+ lifecycle campaigns.
Ran multi-touch attribution modeling and a structured A/B testing program (50% win rate), improving CTR by 30%.
Built Tableau-driven audience insights to optimize email program performance.
Automated customer journeys with dynamic, segment-driven email content.
Led lifecycle strategy and audience targeting across email and paid social, aligning C-suite stakeholders on data-driven marketing execution.

attribution-lab.name: From Attribution to Ad Spend, Budget Allocation Framework (portfolio site)
bullets: Built an interactive case study linking attribution to budget: deduplicated conversion counts, first/last/linear/position-based models side by side, lift-test calibration, and a diminishing-returns optimizer that reallocates spend on marginal cost per incremental customer.

Built a live UTM Journey Tracker: a UTM taxonomy enforced in code, first-party capture with event_id dedup into Postgres (Neon), read-time tag-quality checks, and a real-time dashboard of visitor journeys; honors Global Privacy Control.

podflow.name: PodFlow, M.S. Data Science Capstone, Eastern University, 2025
bullets: Built a full audio-to-insight pipeline solo: transcription (faster-Whisper), automatic content segmentation via a trained CNN-BiLSTM model (benchmarked against XGBoost, focal loss for class imbalance), and LLM-based metadata enrichment, served through a REST API to a working web app.

Built an offline evaluation framework scoring precision/recall/F1 against hand-labeled ground truth, and deployed a local quantized LLM (Qwen2.5 via llama.cpp) with a rules-based fallback for resilience.

chefai.name: ChefAI, Agentic Meal-Planning Assistant (LangGraph)
bullets: Built a conversational meal-planning agent on a LangGraph state machine, using a conditional router that dispatches to whichever slot (allergies, diet, dislikes, craving, prep time, budget) still needs filling, with LLM-based extraction pulling structured fields from free text.
Made a deliberate agent-autonomy-versus-structure tradeoff: accepted added latency and cost from LLM-based slot extraction for a materially better conversational experience than a rigid form.

resume-chat.name: Resume Chat, Retrieval-Augmented Q&A (portfolio site)
bullets: Built the site's "Ask about Chris" chat: section-chunked retrieval ranked by TF-IDF cosine similarity, grounded generation via OpenRouter, and an automated eval harness scoring factual grounding and out-of-scope refusals.
